# Default Guidance

## Types
- Use the project’s agreed type system
- Do not mix incompatible string-like types

## Style
- Indentation: 2 spaces
- Line length: 80 characters max
- Comments: explain *why*, not *what*

## Git workflow
- Commit message: feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|test|chore
- Branches: feature/|fix/|hotfix/
- PRs require code review
